import pickle

import numpy as np

root = Path('/holdout_task')

    sample['train'] = {key: t[key][i] for key in ('x','y','traj')}
    y, end = t['y'][i], t['traj'][i,-1]
    sample['train']['summary'] = np.array([y.mean(), y.std(), end.mean(), end.std()])
